formal_statement: ∀ (x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo x1 → (∀ (x3 : Fin (9 : ℕ) → Bool), (x1.wires (List.ofFn x3)).getD (9 : ℕ) Bool.false = !x3 (4 : Fin (9 : ℕ))) → x1.size ≤ (15 : ℕ) → (∃ (x5 : Fin (9 : ℕ) → Bool), x1.eval (List.ofFn x5) = Bool.true) → (∀ (x6 : Fin (9 : ℕ)), x1.eval (List.ofFn fun (x7 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (x7 = x6)) = Bool.false) → ∃ (x7 : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate), x7.length = (15 : ℕ) ∧ x7.head? = Option.some { op := PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not, inputs := [(4 : ℕ)] : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate } ∧ (∀ (x8 : Fin x7.length), (∃ (x9 : ℕ) (x10 : ℕ), x9 ≤ x10 ∧ x10 ≤ (9 : ℕ) + ↑x8 ∧ (x7.get x8 = { op := PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and, inputs := [x9, x10] : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate } ∨ x7.get x8 = { op := PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or, inputs := [x9, x10] : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate })) ∨ ∃ x9 ≤ (9 : ℕ) + ↑x8, x7.get x8 = { op := PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not, inputs := [x9] : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate }) ∧ ∀ (x8 : Fin (9 : ℕ) → Bool), { gates := x7, output := (23 : ℕ) : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit }.eval (List.ofFn x8) = x1.eval (List.ofFn x8)
plain_statement: A circuit of AND, OR (two-input) and NOT gates on 9 inputs with at most 15 gates whose first gate computes NOT x_4, true somewhere and false at every input with one input on. Then the same function is computed by a list of exactly 15 gates whose first is NOT x_4, every gate an AND or OR of two wires or a NOT of one wire, reading inputs or wires no later than its own, with the last gate as output.
title: A step toward: Petersen graph minus a vertex: no AND, OR (fan-in two), NOT circuit with at most 15 gates and first gate NOT x_4 computes its edge function
